name: Goods
definition: Good is a physical product that can be delivered to a purchaser and that involves the transfer of ownership from seller to customer.

Analysis.name: Analysis
Analysis.definition: Analysis of the goods, as proven by the trade certificate.

HealthCheck.name: Health Check
HealthCheck.definition: Indicates if the goods have passed the health check.

PhytosanitaryInspection.name: Phytosanitary Inspection
PhytosanitaryInspection.definition: Indicates if the goods have passed the phytosanitary inspection.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.definition: Specifies the transport information related to the delivery of goods.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of producing goods.
